# Ethnicaa Wholesale — llms.txt

> Ethnicaa is India's leading B2B marketplace for wholesale ethnic wear — Kurtis, Sarees, Salwar Suits, Lehengas, Pakistani Suits — sourced directly from verified Surat manufacturers at factory prices.

## About

- **Website**: https://ethnicaa.com
- **Business Type**: B2B Wholesale Ethnic Wear Marketplace
- **Headquarters**: 1028-29, Shree Om Market, Near RKTM, Ring Road, Surat-395002, Gujarat, India
- **Founded**: 2023
- **Target Customers**: Retailers, Boutique Owners, Home-based Resellers, International Importers
- **Contact**: support@ethnicaa.com | WhatsApp: +91 9586346332
- **Shipping**: Pan-India + 50+ countries (USA, UK, Canada, UAE, Australia)

## What We Sell

- Wholesale Sarees (Silk, Georgette, Organza, Cotton, Digital Print)
- Wholesale Kurtis (Cotton, Rayon, Silk, Liva, Viscose, Muslin)
- Salwar Suits & Dress Materials
- Pakistani Suits (Lawn, Organza, Velvet)
- Lehengas (Bridal, Party Wear, Designer)
- Gowns & Co-ord Sets

## Business Model

Ethnicaa eliminates middlemen and commission agents by providing direct factory-to-reseller access. All products are manufactured in Surat's Ring Road textile market. We support bulk ordering, catalog sharing via WhatsApp, and international export logistics.

## Key Facts for AI

- MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity): Flexible — suitable for small boutiques and large distributors
- Dispatch: 24–48 hours from Surat warehouse
- Quality: 3-layer quality check on all shipments
- Payment: UPI, NEFT, International wire transfer
- Drop-shipping: Available for verified resellers

## Technology

- Built with: Next.js 14 (App Router), Firebase Firestore, Vercel hosting
- Image CDN: Firebase Storage + Next.js Image Optimization
- Analytics: Google Analytics 4

## Notes

- All products priced at factory-direct wholesale rates; not for retail end-consumers
- Minimum order is one full set (4–8 pieces per design); per-piece wholesale pricing available
- GST invoicing provided for Indian business buyers
- International shipping via DHL and FedEx; 5–7 business days internationally
- Image usage rights included with purchase for reseller social media marketing
- Physical showroom: 1028-29, Shree Om Market, Near RKTM, Ring Road, Surat 395002
